provider: Weights & Biases / CoreWeave Forge (academic free tier)

free_tier.stated: Free plan: 5 GB/month of storage. Pro: 100 GB/month. 'Free forever for academic research' tier: 200 GB of cloud storage, unlimited tracked hours, up to 25 GB/month Weave ingestion, up to 100 seats — requires an active academic email address.

egress.terms: Not metered separately for artifact reads; storage is billed as a rolling 30-day consumption average in GB-days, so churn does not help you.

tooling: wandb Python SDK, `wandb artifact` API, artifacts pull via `wandb artifact get`; W&B also accepts 'reference artifacts' pointing at an external bucket (S3/GCS) which do NOT count against quota — that is the real trick here.
chaining: 200 GB per academic account x up to 100 seats in one academic org = 20 TB of quota, but the seats clause is about people, not storage pools — storage is per-entity and would need to be checked. The clean multiplier is reference artifacts: unlimited pointers to external storage at zero quota cost (useful as an index layer over Kaggle/Modal bytes, not as storage itself).
limits_note: 5 GB on the ordinary free tier is the number that bites; academic tier requires a .edu-affiliated active email; the 30-day rolling average means a short burst still costs you; artifact TTL features exist but do not raise the cap.
reliability_note: Migrated from wandb.ai branding to CoreWeave Forge (the pricing page 301s to coreweave.com/forge-pricing) — product continuity is fine, but as an academic user you are now depending on a GPU-cloud vendor's free tier.
